bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_stage_seq_static_c10 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_static_control/ot_s81_fixed_issue.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_static_control/ot_s81_fixed_mailbox.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_static_control/dsfd_stage_seq_static_c.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_static_control/dsfd_stage_seq_static_c10.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_static_control/ot_s81_pq_boot_control.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81issuer_c10_localtree/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81issuer_c10_localtree/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81issuer_c10_localtree --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_stage_seq_static_c10  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Real production c10 full128x76 issuer local registered diagnostic-tree repair, engines0..7+10+12+13 plus actualPQboot mailbox/controller. Distinct measured area and pin plan, no c8 view inheritance. E face engine13/PQboot/host, N face engine10 as assigned by die_live; all original subset pin orders preserved. Raw calendar edges unchanged, fault diagnostic+1edge; recipe3 ck pin stages+1input/+1output, serialmailbox native ckv ports excluded explicitly. Proposed24000um2 area allowance is not synthesis evidence; gate must measure sinks, utilization, native timing.
